in_hebrew.name: Brewer
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו The maker or keeper of beer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Brewer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'breowan', meaning 'to brew'. This name was given to individuals who were involved in the production of beer in the Middle Ages. Brewing was a significant occupation during this time, as beer was the primary source of hydration and a major component of the diet.
